text: Ethics and academic integrity. <break time="0.8s" /> Are foundational aspects. <break time="0.8s" /> For any university student, academic, or researcher. <break time="0.8s" /> This is to ensure the authenticity and credibility of all work. <break time="0.8s" /> Conducted within and by the university. <break time="0.8s" /> Embedding principles of honesty, fairness, and responsibility. <break time="0.8s" /> Guides academic conduct. <break time="0.8s" /> And establishes a culture of trust. <break time="0.8s" /> Integrity in all forms of academic work. <break time="0.8s" /> From research and writing. <break time="0.8s" /> To examinations and collaborative projects. <break time="0.8s" /> Shapes the academic experience for students. <break time="0.8s" /> And has relevance. <break time="0.8s" /> Both in and beyond their world of study. <break time="0.8s" /> Amidst such rapidly advancing technologies. <break time="0.8s" /> Innovative and publicly available AI based tools and capacities. <break time="0.8s" /> Have prompted. <break time="0.8s" /> A reconceptualisation of what it means to maintain academic integrity. <break time="0.8s" /> As students and lecturers navigate this period. <break time="0.8s" /> The challenge lies. <break time="0.8s" /> In harmonising the principles of honesty, fairness, and responsibility. <break time="0.8s" /> With the opportunities presented by AI. <break time="0.8s" /> Such aspirations are leading to a range of approaches. <break time="0.8s" /> That straddle both the practical and restrictive use of AI generated content.
